channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — FinTech
channel.description: Latest FinTech stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: Binance hack laundering ramps up as $149 million in bitcoin mixed through coinjoins: Elliptic
item.description: Hackers have begun laundering $149 million in Bitcoin stolen from Binance in 2019 using privacy-enhancing CoinJoin mixers, according to blockchain analytics firm Elliptic.

item.title: At a glance 2026
item.description: The EIB Group has announced its 2026 strategic focus on clean energy, digitalization, and innovation, supported by updated operational codes and financial instruments.

item.title: Five Days, Three Cities: Europe’s AI Founders Swap Pitches for Proof
item.description: The EIT AI Entrepreneurs Lab concluded its inaugural European tour, helping AI startups pivot toward commercial viability and alignment with the EU AI Act.

item.title: RIF: Cyprus at SLUSH 2026 with 25 innovative companies participating in the national delegation
item.description: Cyprus sent its largest-ever delegation of 25 innovative companies to SLUSH 2026 in Helsinki, signaling the rapid internationalization of the island's tech ecosystem.

item.title: EU and EIB back Medusa to strengthen Mediterranean digital links and connect Jordan’s research community
item.description: The EU and EIB are funding the extension of the Medusa submarine cable to Jordan, enhancing digital connectivity and research collaboration across the Mediterranean, including Cyprus.

item.title: EIB Vice President Fayolle travels to South Africa to strengthen the partnership with the country, focusing on health, clean transport and critical minerals
item.description: EIB Vice-President Fayolle visits South Africa to finalize €425M+ in financing for critical minerals, vaccine production, and green transport infrastructure.

item.title: Beata Javorcik appointed EIB Group Chief Economist
item.description: Beata Javorcik, current EBRD Chief Economist, will join the EIB Group in April 2027 to lead strategic economic analysis and investment priorities.

item.title: MoonPay applies for national trust bank charter to expand stablecoin services
item.description: Crypto infrastructure provider MoonPay has applied for a US National Trust Bank charter to scale its stablecoin and custodial services globally.

item.title: CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US
item.description: CFTC Chair Summer Mersinger outlined a regulatory roadmap for decentralized exchanges like Hyperliquid to operate legally in the US, highlighting significant shifts in crypto oversight.

item.title: Opening Keynote speech by the Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus, Mr Demetris Skourides, at the 5th CSN Greece ICT Conference 2026
item.description: Cyprus' Chief Scientist outlines a strategy for AI integration in shipping, emphasizing reliability, human oversight, and the transition from data collection to predictive foresight.

item.title: Basel Committee discusses risks and vulnerabilities faced by global banking system
item.description: The Basel Committee is updating global banking standards to address risks from AI financing, third-party dependencies, and cryptoassets, signaling tighter supervision for 2027-28.

item.title: EIT Governing Board advances water innovation, extends urban mobility partnership and agrees to strengthen oversight
item.description: The EIT has finalized the startup phase for EIT Water and extended EIT Urban Mobility's partnership, while implementing stricter financial oversight and compliance measures.

item.title: Address by the Deputy Minister of Research, Innovation and Digital Policy at the Cyprus Institute of Neurology and Genetics Graduation
item.description: The Deputy Minister of Research addressed 70 new CING graduates, emphasizing the role of resilience in scientific innovation and the Institute's impact on Cyprus's biomedical sector.

item.title: Deputy Minister of Migration, Research Deputy Minister – Press Conference
item.description: The Cyprus government announces the digitisation of Migration Department services to improve efficiency and support the national digital transformation strategy.

item.title: Temu and Mastercard expand collaboration on digital payments and local business support
item.description: Temu and Mastercard have expanded their partnership to enhance digital payment security, streamline checkout processes, and explore financial tools for local sellers globally.

item.title: It’s time to prepare for a post-quantum future today
item.description: Mastercard has launched a Quantum Advisory Practice and published guidance to help financial institutions prepare for "harvest now, decrypt later" cyber threats.

item.title: Ericsson and Mastercard enhance global digital money movement and accelerate digital financial inclusion
item.description: Ericsson and Mastercard have integrated their platforms to simplify global money movement for telecoms and fintechs, targeting unbanked populations via mobile wallets.

item.title: Annual inflation up to 4.0% in the euro area
item.description: Euro area inflation hit 4.0% in October 2026, with Cyprus significantly exceeding the average at 5.4%, primarily driven by energy and services costs.

item.title: CITEA AT THE FOREFRONT OF THE CYPRUS–INDIA TECHNOLOGY PARTNERSHIP
item.description: CITEA is building strategic AI and technology partnerships with India to enhance the expertise of the Cyprus tech ecosystem beyond simple service outsourcing.

item.title: Netherlands: Gradyent secures €20 million European venture debt financing to scale smart heating systems
item.description: Dutch energy-tech firm Gradyent secured a €20 million EIB venture loan to scale its AI-driven digital twin software for heating and cooling network optimization.

item.title: PRESS RELEASE – Strengthening International Connections for Cypriot Innovation through the Plug and Play APAC Summit in Singapore
item.description: Cyprus strengthens its innovation ties with the Asia-Pacific region through participation in the Plug and Play APAC Summit 2026 in Singapore.

item.title: RIF PRESS RELEASE – Cyprus Delegation in Silicon Valley: Building New Bridges for Investment, Innovation and International Growth
item.description: A high-level Cyprus delegation visited Silicon Valley to pitch local startups to major international venture funds and establish strategic innovation partnerships.

item.title: Press Release: RIF Director General Participates in Falling Walls Science Summit in Berlin
item.description: RIF Director General Theodoros Loukaidis engaged with European science leaders in Berlin to discuss innovation ecosystem coordination and strategic resilience.

item.title: PRESS RELEASE – Cyprus Ranks 3rd in Southern Europe for Corporate Startup Activity
item.description: Cyprus ranks 3rd in Southern Europe for corporate startup engagement in the 2026 Index, highlighted by strong performance from Bank of Cyprus and ASBISc.

item.title: The 2026 EIT Awards finalists revealed!
item.description: The European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT) has announced its 2026 award finalists, highlighting top European ventures in mobility, health, and sustainable food.

item.title: Lighter reopens withdrawals after trader's API key leak, returns about $5 million in USDC
item.description: Lighter decentralized exchange resumed withdrawals after a protocol pause triggered by an API key leak that risked $5 million in USDC.

item.title: Stablecoin infrastructure firm Avenia raises $25 million in Series A extension
item.description: Avenia secured $25 million to scale its stablecoin infrastructure, focusing on bridging traditional finance and digital assets through global regulatory-compliant payment solutions.

item.title: Grayscale says crypto pullback offers 'compelling entry points' as bitcoin falls to $64,000
item.description: Grayscale identifies Bitcoin's recent drop to $64,000 as a "compelling entry point," citing strong fundamentals despite market volatility.

item.title: Romanian city of Ploiești to upgrade tram network with €36 million in EIB financing and €9 million in EU grants
item.description: The EIB and EU are providing €45 million to modernize Ploiești's tram network, marking Romania's first project under the Public Sector Loan Facility.

item.title: EIB unlocks half of planned €800 million in financing for Romania’s Cernavodă nuclear plant refurbishment
item.description: The EIB has released €400 million of a planned €800 million loan to refurbish Romania's Cernavodă nuclear plant, securing long-term low-carbon energy for the region.

item.title: Digital firms drive surge in business R&D as government R&D budgets across the OECD fall for a second consecutive year
item.description: Global public R&D budgets are declining for a second year while private sector digital and AI R&D spending surges by double digits.

item.title: EIC Fund companies highlight its role in supporting fundraising and growth
item.description: A new EIC Fund survey confirms its vital role in startup fundraising and credibility, while highlighting a growing focus on dual-use and defense technologies.

item.title: Infocredit Group and Mastercard to Sponsor the 27th NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum in Cyprus
item.description: Meet the team on 19 November 2026 at the Four Seasons Hotel in Limassol to discuss financial crime compliance, payment fraud prevention and third-party cyber risk.

item.title: Mastercard and World Bank Group launch $500 million global risk facility to expand financial access
item.description: Mastercard and the World Bank's IFC launch a $500M risk facility to expand digital payment access in emerging markets, including those in Europe.

item.title: CYPRUS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ENTREPRISES ASSOCIATION EVENT
item.description: CITEA hosted a networking event to promote synergies among Cyprus IT companies and highlight international development opportunities through the Trade Service.

item.title: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack, sending KAVA token down nearly 40%
item.description: DeFi lending protocol Kava Lend suffered a $3.8 million exploit, causing the KAVA token to plummet by 40% amid wider market stability concerns.

item.title: Mastercard launches Wallet Pay to scale digital wallets worldwide
item.description: Mastercard's new Wallet Pay solution enables digital wallet providers to scale globally and achieve interoperability across millions of acceptance points.

item.title: Scams: What to watch out for ahead of Black Friday and Christmas shopping traffic
item.description: Cyprus banks warn of a seasonal surge in phishing and social engineering scams targeting consumers during the Black Friday and Christmas shopping period.

item.title: The European Innovation Council selects 35 deep tech companies for its Accelerator support
item.description: The European Innovation Council awards €84 million to 35 deep tech companies, offering grants and equity to scale breakthrough innovations across the EU.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1 billion for the second week in a row as crypto funds, except one, continue bleeding
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $1 billion in weekly outflows for the second consecutive week, signaling a cooling of institutional crypto demand amid market volatility.

item.title: CYPRUS SHAPES ITS DIGITAL FUTURE: CLOUD, TALENT AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN THE SPOTLIGHT
item.description: CITEA and government officials convened to align on Cyprus' National AI Strategy, "Cloud First" public sector policy, and international talent acquisition to drive digital competitiveness.

item.title: TEMU PARTNERS WITH CITEA TO SUPPORT CYPRUS’ DIGITAL BUSINESS COMMUNITY
item.description: Global e-commerce giant Temu has partnered with CITEA to integrate Cyprus's ICT sector and local merchants into its international digital commerce ecosystem.

item.title: CITEA AND INVEST CYPRUS STRENGTHEN COOPERATION FOR CYPRUS’ DIGITAL DEVELOPMENT AND INTERNATIONAL OUTREACH
item.description: CITEA and Invest Cyprus have signed an MoU to bridge local tech firms with international investors, focusing on AI strategy and digital transformation.

item.title: Regulation as a Competitive Advantage: How the European Framework Strengthens Cyprus as an International Financial Centre
item.description: Cyprus is leveraging the EU's rigorous regulatory framework to pivot from a 'light-touch' jurisdiction to a trusted, high-credibility hub for institutional investment and fintech operations.

item.title: Strengthening Resilience in the Cyprus Funds Industry
item.description: The Cyprus funds industry faces heightened operational risks due to the unprecedented scale and complexity of EU restrictive measures post-2022.

item.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AT THE CORE OF DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION AT THE 5th DIGITAL CYPRUS CONFERENCE 2026
item.description: The 5th Digital Cyprus Conference highlighted Artificial Intelligence as the primary driver for national digital transformation and economic competitiveness in the Cypriot business landscape.

item.title: REMARKABLE SUCCESS FOR THE 2ND CITEA DIGITAL CYPRUS CONFERENCE
item.description: The 2nd CITEA Digital Cyprus Conference drew 600+ delegates to discuss AI, cybersecurity, and digital transformation trends shaping the local business landscape.

item.title: Global standard-setting bodies publish a toolkit for cyber resilience at FMIs and a discussion paper on FMIs’ reliance on third-party service providers
item.description: Global standard-setters CPMI-IOSCO have released a cyber resilience toolkit and a discussion paper on third-party risks for financial market infrastructures, seeking industry feedback.

item.title: Basel III risk-based capital and leverage ratios are stable while liquidity indicators show limited movements for large internationally active banks, latest Basel III monitoring exercise shows
item.description: The latest Basel III monitoring report shows stable capital and leverage ratios for major banks, with a minor increase in minimum required capital impact to 2.2%.

item.title: International supervisory community meets to discuss the future of global bank supervision and regulation
item.description: Global banking supervisors met at ICBS 2026 to discuss modernizing regulation, digital finance impacts, and strengthening cross-border cooperation to ensure financial stability.
